title: WfGg Radar operational discovery and controlled runtime evolution
problem: Prevent Radar Autopilot from stopping the whole discovery chain when a server seed repeatedly yields no exploitable map data, while preserving valid historical evidence and retaining hard stops for global/auth/network failures.
goals: Classify repeated all-region no-data failures for a single seed separately from global runtime failures.
Retry a no-data seed up to three times, then mark it SKIPPED_NO_DATA instead of failing the entire Autopilot.
Preserve any existing valid 9/9 evidence already associated with the skipped seed.
Do not count a skipped seed as a confirmed cluster.
Automatically continue with Seed Scout and the next candidate seed.
Keep authentication, network, decode, ingest and infrastructure failures as blocking safety conditions.
Keep Last War operations read-only and retain Collector writes only for normal discovery evidence.
Qualify and deploy the change through ChaCha DEV with a guard-only pilot probe that executes no Last War scan.
non_goals: Do not treat authentication, network, decode, ingest, timeout, disk or executable failures as empty/no-data servers.
Do not delete or rewrite historical Collector evidence.
Do not count partial or skipped seeds toward the three-cycle confirmation requirement.
Do not create a permanent Last War token or change the V6.19.5 12-hour sliding Radar UI session policy.
Do not execute a real game scan during the pilot guard probe.

current_change.purpose: Server-side Autopilot continuation: after three conservative no-data failures on one seed, preserve existing valid evidence, record the seed as skipped, and continue Seed Scout instead of terminating the entire job.

acceptance_criteria: The connector reports Autopilot version v6.19.6.
Only a failed cycle with zero completed regions, at least nine failed regions, zero players, and nine region failures classified as PROTOCOL or SERVER_TARGET can enter the no-data retry path.
Auth, network, timeout, ingest, decode, template/binary/exec, disk, memory and permission indicators are excluded from the no-data path.
A no-data seed is retried three times by default before being recorded as SKIPPED_NO_DATA.
Existing valid 9/9 cycle IDs and counts for a skipped seed are preserved in skipped-seed evidence.
Skipped seeds do not increment ConfirmedClusters.
After a skip, CurrentSeed is cleared and Seed Scout continues automatically.
The existing AUTOPILOT_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURE_LIMIT and AUTOPILOT_AUTH_FAILED guards remain present for true failures.
Pilot installation is SHA-pinned, rollback-capable and verified with no Last War scan or Collector mutation.
Production promotion requires a separate explicit human approval.
architecture_invariants: GitHub stores code, branches, CI and release artifacts.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS is the runtime orchestrator.
ChaChaNas remains authoritative persistent storage for project data and backups.
VPS is runtime-oriented and not the authoritative durable project store.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
